description: The signature ground cover of the Silent Grove Enclave. Grove Deepmoss changes slowly, and its shift is among the last indicators to register in the Feywood's seven-stage decline order — any visible change in Grove Deepmoss signals deep instability. Druidic use only, in tiny amounts if at all.

ecology.cultural_role: slow-change sign of deeper instability; druidic-use-only
ecology.ecological_role: signature ground cover of the Silent Grove
